LanguageData.SSC_MasterQualificationItem.label: Master qualification module
LanguageData.SSC_MasterQualificationItem.description: A certification module containing training knowledge. Permanently unlocks Master selection without changing identity. With Royalty, supplies missing Training techprints; normal research is still required. Only unqualified pawns who are not SSC sex slaves can use it. Success consumes 1. Qualification transfers with personality; clones do not inherit it. Found in quest and ancient ruin rewards, not sold by traders.
